store_listing.value: Offline baby diary. Free forever, no ads, no signup. Feeding, sleep, growth.

privacy.value: The listing says records stay in a local SQLite database, with no account, analytics, advertising identifiers or third-party SDKs. Google Play declares no data collected or shared.

limitations.value: MimiLog does not replace professional medical advice. Data does not sync automatically between devices.

features.name: Breastfeeding timer, bottle feeds, solids and automatic night-feed detection
Nap and overnight sleep logs with wake-window estimates
Weight, height and head circumference on WHO percentile curves
Temperature history with seven-level fever classification
Multiple baby profiles, statistics and CSV, Excel or JSON export
